newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU awards free-market grain exports.
newsitem.headline: EU awards free-market grain exports.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted exports of 436,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 10.25 Ecus per tonne, European grain industry sources said.
It also granted 398,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum refund of 26.98 Ecus per tonne, they said.
The EU, at a weekly tender, also awarded 23,500 tonnes of oats for general export to third countries at 29.34 Ecus per tonne, the sources said.
